thumb.alt: Landing page for an online course

title: Landing page for an online course
lead: A course landing with an offer, a program by weeks, two price columns, a FAQ and an application form.
problem: An author selling an English course for IT people needs a landing page: a clear offer, who it is for (front end, back end, QA, devops), a six-week program, what students get, two price columns, a FAQ and an application form.
built: A first screen with a clear offer and a live practice-call widget.
A who-it's-for block with real situations for each role.
A six-week program laid out as a timeline.
A what-you-get block showing what the course materials look like.
Two price columns, an about-the-author block and a FAQ.
steps: The first screen states the offer.
The visitor picks their role and sees real situations for it.
The program is shown week by week.
Two plans, a FAQ and an application form close the page.
offer: A course landing built from your texts and materials.
Applications sent to your Telegram, email or CRM (part of a real order).
not_included: Hosting, domain and third-party service fees.
